description: Ministry of Health - The Food (Tran - Fat) Regulations - 2022
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the Food Act, No. 26 of 1980. The content establishes new legal requirements and restrictions regarding trans-fat content in food products, labeling requirements, and prohibitions on partially hydrogenated oils. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it involves the creation of new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements under existing legislation.
